findings.title: RPI INSTALL incoming item names reach shell commands
findings.summary: Enabled RPI management INSTALL iterates original incoming items after copying known values, then interpolates selected item.name unquoted into popen. JSON accepts arbitrary names and bus dispatch does not whitelist versions. Requires initialized INSTALL and permission to change Server; executes shell syntax with server privileges. Source-contract confirmation only; no command payload executed.
findings.remediation: Reject unknown version items, iterate validated canonical selection, and use an argument-vector helper invocation or correct quoting. Verify with intercepted invocation without installing packages.

findings.title: RPI management helper ALERT text becomes printf format
findings.summary: execute_command supplies helper ALERT text as indigo_update_property format without arguments. Maintained rpi_ctrl.sh:574-578 and rpi_ctrl_v2.sh:565-569 echo failed date input from HOST_TIME, preserving percent directives despite shell quoting. Deployed s_rpi_ctrl.sh wrapper contract required; actual packaging untested. Undefined variadic reads can crash/disclose data; write directives can corrupt memory. Source-only confirmation, no exploitation run.
findings.remediation: Use literal %s or raw-update API for helper output; handle absent message explicitly; test percent-containing diagnostics with stub helper.

findings.title: Blank ACL lines read before stack buffer
findings.summary: Documented supported blank/whitespace-only ACL lines decrement len below zero in trailing-space loop. Exact extracted loader with stub setters/logging and newline-only fixture triggers UBSan index -1 and ASan stack-buffer-underflow on clean temporary Clang build. Local config availability defect, not remote security bypass.
findings.remediation: Keep len >= 0 in whitespace-loop condition and regress blank, whitespace, comment and normal records under sanitizers.
